- Launcher: an app opened from it comes up in the look that is on in the launcher; the Store is no longer on the desktop by default (a switch in the launcher settings brings it back).
- Video player: a dead zone on the left and right edges (Settings > Gestures, 0 to 48 dp), so a swipe that starts at the edge does not seek or change anything.
- Game Hub: a disc shows the middle of the cover instead of the whole picture squeezed; the case view has an edge dead zone; two fingers no longer steer the shelf (it jumped around and played a sound at every step); in the Mix, games with the same box style sit side by side.
- Game Hub: API keys are typed in a real Android text dialog, so the keyboard always comes up; a game with no cover is looked up again after 6 hours.
- Crash log: Download/Pulse/crash-log.txt now keeps every crash and, from Android 11 on, every unusual end of a Pulse process (a crash while the app is closed, a native crash, a hang, a kill for memory) with the system's own reason.
